notes.title: UPDATE 1.08 - Small Changes With the Quad Mode Bombs
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902289/a45c05489e2d367bbdef8c00f7284342837ef3c8.jpg[/img]

Just a really quick update that does two things when you choose to play the Quad mode of Dice-Zee:

1) The Bomb buttons now make an audible click sound when you choose and click on one and they now fade out much faster than before.

2) You're now given a brief description of how the bombs work on the bomb selection screen at the bottom of the screen.

Remember that you must have enough DZ coins to purchase at least one bomb and you can never have more than three bombs at the start of your game.. If either is the case, you will not be offered a choice to purchase any bombs with DZ coins.


That's it for this update!  Enjoy!


Sincerely,

ZaxtorGameS ... (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.07 - BOMBS Are Live! - Blow Up Those Bad Dice Rolls in Quad Dice-Zee!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902289/e98bf47d9b1cfb81e3af80acd9e63c6c8c6458b6.jpg[/img]

Ever get four sixes your first roll and roll two more times only to curse that last dice for not rolling on the number six like his four brothers?  ..How about rolling a 2, a 3, a 4, and a 5 with the first roll and only need a large straight to take the leaderboards high score?  ..Wouldn't a few more chances to get that dice roll you need be just epic?

..Wait no longer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902289/276d125d8a81e8ace5d1bb407bf2e36f89c7a94c.jpg[/img]

You now can purchase up to THREE BOMBS before every game of Quad DiceZee that you play!  The costs will come up at the beginning of every Quad DiceZee that you start and the bombs can then be simply dragged and dropped onto any dice that you don't like!  KA-BOOM!  You get to extract your anger out on it for not doing as you were willing it to do!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902289/ea1aa40ed725fb9bc95f956d3a24beed947c5c69.jpg[/img]

The bombs you purchase will even save and carry over to your next game if you don't use them!

To use a bomb in this new update, simply finish your last roll (roll #3) and wait for the dice to stop rolling.  Then simply drag a dice that you've purchased with DZ coins and drop it onto the uncooperative dice and watch it explode in go up in a cloud of dust!  ..Once it has been obliterated, you'll get a button allowing you to re-roll that dice and once again scream and holler at it to "be better" and "roll better"!

Keep in mind that only a maximum of three dice bombs can be used in any one game and that they do cost precious DZ coins so make those dice bombing decisions count when it really matters the most to witness some true game changing moments and explosions!  

NOTE:  Dice bombs have NOT been addednd are not planned for the regular version of DiceZee. 

I hope you all enjoy my newest twist on the classic dice rolling game of Quad DiceZee!  Have FUN with it!


Sincerely,

ZaxtorGameS .. (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.06 - More Dice Roll Polish
notes.notes:
In Update 1.06, all I've done is polish the dice rolling mechanics so that they should now always roll more naturally and also if they land on top of each other, they slide away from each other better than before.

I've also made it so that you can press the ROLL DICE button a half of a second sooner than before, so you no longer have to wait for the roll dice button to completely fade in before it will allow you to press it to roll again if you are in a hurry.  It feels better now in my opinion and that's what's important.


Not much here, just small details which should mean a little better experience for you, the user.

NOTE:  Update 1.05 which I made way back on April 3rd was also a similar small details patch to this, I just forgot to write up an update event description for it.. Just a 'FYI'.


Sincerely,

ZaxtorGameS ... {Solo Indie Game Developer}

notes.title: UPDATE 1.04 - First Polish Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902289/be19934eb1ac5f8cbffbcfe7411c13724094df4c.jpg[/img]

Hello all,

With this update comes polish to the game, the first of several ideas I have to help polish the game and just make it a more enjoyable game to play overall.

- Crowd cheer stopped with a pleasant little jingle added whenever you start a regular or a Quad Dice-Zee game.  Both the regular and Quad games now have their own separate and different little 'start game' tunes.  This way, it will hopefully kinda help separate the games if you click on the 'Play Again' button when a game is over.

- The Roll button now fades whenever you roll the dice and stays faded in the background until all of the dice stop moving.  I believe this helps make the game look cleaner and more professional overall.

- The dice rolling mechanics are still a work in progress and have been given more love with this update.  This will continue to be worked on until I am really, really happy with the overall look of how they roll and bounce of each other and the edges of the rolling area.

- The game now saves every DZ coin you collect as soon as you collect it to make sure that even if you don't finish a game, you'll keep every DZ coin you've earned.

- Your lifetime stats on the leaderboards screen (High Rollers) now fade in and fade out cleaner and more smoothly than before.


That is it for this update, the 4th update I've given to Dice-Zee since it launched last week.  As with all of my games that I've launched since 2017, I will continue to make updates and show love to this game, regardless of how well or how little it might sell.

If you enjoy Dice-Zee, please consider leaving me a review to let other players know all about it, and also be sure to tell your friends and family on your social media platforms that you regularly use!

Thank you for playing, thank you for your support, and have a great weekend!


Sincerely,

ZaxtorGameS ... {Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.03 - Critical Quad Gamble Event Bug Fixed & Basic Rules Added!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902289/8d3c91534aedb118322262e22225edbd5cef3214.jpg[/img]

In this critical update for the Quad Dice-Zee mode, I've fixed a critical bug that would cause the four-option gamble event window to NOT allow you to make a selection, thus resulting in this window pop-up not even disappearing as intended.  It simply would not allow you to make a choice at all in most situations, even the choice to skip betting your DZ coins on the score event.

I sincerely apologize for this bug as it was made when I was trying to put in the whole gamble event on the last score event on the Quad game mode right before launch and I was up wayyy too late coding it in, making the critical typos.

Now that that is fixed, I've also added some very basic rules to the game that can be seen by simply hitting the space bar from the welcome screen in the game.


That's it for this small but very important update, especially to the Quad Dice-Zee mode.



Sincerely,

ZaxtorGameS ... (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.02 - Better Dice Bounces, New Flashing Confirmation Box!
notes.notes:
Hello gamers, dice rollers, and people just reading to read...

In this update 1.02, I've added a new visual and another confirmation sound effect every time that you confirm a score being drawn and added to your score card..  You'll now see a blinking box and hear an audio buzz right where the score is drawn on the score card by your pencil.

Never fear however, as this new setting can be turned off and back on right in the game settings as seen right here:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902289/c8bfd57dceb8f742d2a5dad032c9d7e368f60321.jpg[/img]


Also, I've worked out some of the kinks in the code to I believe stop dice from getting bounced off the screen at times.  This stuff can get really finicky, but if I witness or hear of dice still getting deflecting off the game table in my game, I'll continue to work this code until I get it just right.


That's about it for this update, but expect more to come as I do have more ideas for all new ways to both earn and spend your DZ coins in the game!


Sincerely,

ZaxtorGameS ... (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.01 - Discord Button Added, ..Wise and Funny Pun Lines Added!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902289/3a1f1f2403a03e38592974071143a5185564b41b.png[/img]

Hello Dice Rollers!

The first update since the launch just yesterday is already in with update 1.01 today!

Here are the changes made in this update:

- The dice rolling and bouncing off of each other physics and mechanics were a little wonky at times, and they are still not where I want them to be.  But this update definitely is a step in the right direction as I made sure that their deflection angles are never the exact same as another dice to prevent two dice looking like they are in the same spot going the same direction.  More updates will come to resolve the issues of them sometimes bouncing off the screen.  Just think of this occurrence as them bouncing off of the table but the game will always put them back on your screen at the end of each roll should it happen!

- Over 70 one liners, some intended to make you smile or laugh have been added to the Welcome screen.  Please let me know your favorite lines and if you'd like to see more of these added over time!

- A 'Join the Discord' button has been added to the welcome screen so that people can easily join the ZaxtorGameS discord right from the game.

- One key in-game buttons such as what the Escape key and Tab key buttons do have been listed in the game settings accessed by clicking on the 'ZG' gear at the top left of the Welcome screen.

- Some of the sound effects that were too loud have been lowered as well as some of the sound effects that were too low of a volume have been slightly increase in volume to try and balance all of the sound effects in the game better.

- A typo in the code that would prevent you from being able to purchase the "Radiant Ruby' dice with DZ coins has been fixed.

-------

That's all for this update and as with all my other games on Steam, I will continue to add, fix, and polish this game over time.  

Thanks for playing and thanks for reading this!


Sincerely,

ZaxtorGameS .. (Solo Indie Game Developer)
